name: Edomites
overview: The Edomites, also known as Edom, are the descendants of Esau, who was the elder twin brother of Jacob. Scripture reveals the divine prophecy that the elder would serve the younger, indicating a future where Esau's descendants would be subordinate to Jacob's lineage. Isaac's blessing to Esau foretells a life sustained by the sword and living under the dominion of his brother, highlighting the complex relationship between these two nations. This background sets the stage for understanding the historical and spiritual significance of the Edomites in relation to Israel.
